description: This file contains the implementation of PoolingStreamBufferWriter, a struct that implements IBufferWriter<byte> and IDisposable for writing to a Stream using pooled byte arrays as buffers. It manages buffer resizing, advancing, and disposal, facilitating efficient stream writing with pooled memory.

classes.name: PoolingStreamBufferWriter
classes.description: A struct implementing IBufferWriter<byte> for writing to a Stream with pooled buffers, supporting buffer management, advancing, and disposal.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Writes data to the stream and updates the internal buffer position.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Provides a Memory<byte> segment for writing, resizing buffer if necessary.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Provides a Span<byte> segment for writing, resizing buffer if necessary.

methods.name: Resize
methods.description: Resizes the internal buffer to accommodate additional data.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Returns the pooled buffer to the pool, releasing resources.
